chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked him about a man leading women in salat (prayer). He said:
"Yes. And if there are young boys with them, then place them in front of the women, even if they are servants."

key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: the women being led in salat (prayer)
key_terms.غِلْمَانٌ: young boys present with the group
key_terms.فَأَقِيمُوهُمْ: then position them or make them stand
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads in congregational salat (prayer) as Imam

ai.seo_question: Can a man lead women in congregational salat (prayer), and where should young boys stand?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding congregational salat (prayer) in which a man leads women. It also instructs that if young boys are present, they should be positioned in front of the women, even if those boys are servants.
